name: line-mtc
description: Shared aircraft running log and Even G2 companion

scripts.pack: npm run build:companion && evenhub pack app.json dist-companion --sdk-ver 0.0.16 -o line-mtc-1.0.5.ehpk
scripts.build:server: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && cp server/main.mjs server/store.mjs server/init-data.mjs server-build/
scripts.test:shared: npm run build && npm run build:server && LINE_MTC_COMPANION_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3077 npm run build:companion && playwright test -c playwright.shared.config.ts
